what_was_adopted: The preregistration is in force. T4E.12 candidate 1 -- candidate C's pairs admitted only when a distance as small as their own would arise with probability at most alpha / m^2 under a tail model fitted to that same scene pair's own cross-scene distances -- is the declared attempt at an identity criterion whose admissions do not grow with the configuration population. The declaration was written, committed and hashed before any development block was evaluated under it.
what_adoption_does_not_mean: It is not a prediction that candidate 1 will work. It says only that it is a scientifically defensible candidate worth measuring and that the conditions for calling it a success or a failure were fixed before the measurement. If it fails it is to be recorded as failed.
what_was_not_adopted: It is NOT adopted as the identity criterion. Adoption authorises the development evaluation on the already-inspected blocks and the null block, at the three declared richness levels, and nothing further. The reserved confirmatory blocks stay reserved until development evidence supports proceeding and a further amendment records that.
what_is_not_adjustable_by_this_adoption: alpha stays at 0.05, the threshold percentile at 1.0, and the minimum exceedance count at 50. Adoption does not license trying values and keeping the best; any such value chosen by looking at these blocks would be fitted to already-inspected data. A different setting is a further candidate needing its own declaration, its own adoption, and an evaluation on data these blocks did not select.
the_acceptance_clause_this_is_measured_a: T4E.12's acceptance was amended in the open before this candidate was declared: as first written it required a candidate to be a change to what the signature carries, which would have excluded a procedural correction. The four numbered acceptance conditions are unchanged by that amendment, and this candidate is measured against them as written.
scope_adopted: Atmospheric identity path only. Adopting this here adopts it nowhere else. Cross-domain use of the same mechanism requires its own declared experiment under the cross-domain programme and its own qualification, per R19.
governing: R20: candidate 1 is evaluated alone. It is not compared against T4E.11's candidates to pick a winner; all four of those are already falsified. Candidate C appears as the proposer of pairs and candidate D's matched fraction as an arithmetic reference for acceptance condition 2, neither of which is adjudication.
Development results on the already-inspected blocks are development evidence and may not be reported as confirmation.

development_outcome.richness_6: WHOLLY REFUSED: every scene pair, every block.
development_outcome.summary: The criterion admitted nothing: not one pair across four blocks at richness 9, four blocks at richness 12, or either null partition. False split is therefore 1.0 wherever it could be computed, against an accepted 0.10. At richness 6 the tail model could not be fitted at all and every scene pair was refused by name.
development_outcome.what_the_null_says_and_why_it_matters_mo: The declaration fixed in advance that if the tail model is correct, admissions per scene pair equal alpha by construction whatever the signature is like. Nominal was 0.05; measured 0.0000. The fitted model is CONSERVATIVE -- it under-admits relative to its own nominal rate -- so this measurement is not a verdict on the signature. THE SIGNATURE WAS NOT CLEANLY TESTED by this candidate.
development_outcome.a_gap_in_this_declaration_s_own_diagnost: The diagnostic named 'far above alpha' as indicting the tail model and did not name 'far below alpha', which is what happened. The direction that occurred was not among the ones the declaration prepared to interpret. That is a defect in the declaration and is recorded rather than edited away.
development_outcome.how_short_it_actually_falls: Sampled directly in four scene pairs: the motif's fitted tail probability sits 9.1x, 6.0x, 3.5x and 15.3x above the admission bound (block 100-105 at richness 9 and 12, then block 300-305 at the same two). A single-digit to low-double-digit factor, not orders of magnitude. NO TREND IN RICHNESS IS CLAIMED: block 100-105 improves from 9.1x to 6.0x and block 300-305 worsens from 3.5x to 15.3x, on two blocks, which settles nothing.
development_outcome.two_feasibility_failures_that_were_deriv: First: 50 exceedances at a 1st-percentile threshold requires at least 5,000 distances, so at least 71 configurations, so at least 9 features. Richness 6 offers 400 distances and 4 exceedances and could never have been evaluated. Second: the motif is a member of the sample the tail is fitted to, and a fitted tail assigns a point near its own sample edge a probability of roughly the exceedance rate divided by the exceedance count -- 1.4e-4 at richness 9 -- while the bound is alpha/m^2 = 7.1e-6. The extrapolation does go below that floor, but not by the factor required. Neither of these needed a measurement to find.
development_outcome.the_lesson_this_declaration_teaches: Candidate D taught that the falsification-licensing field must be narrow, and that correction held here. This one teaches a different check that was missing: a declaration needs a FEASIBILITY test before adoption -- can this criterion admit anything at all, in principle, at the support declared for it? Both failures above answer no and both were available on paper. The falsification reasoning was right and the arithmetic behind the experiment was not checked.
development_outcome.what_this_does_not_authorise: Raising alpha. Moving the threshold percentile or the minimum exceedance count. Dropping richness 6 from the declared levels. Each would be tuning against blocks that have now been inspected repeatedly, and each is a further candidate needing its own declaration, its own adoption, and evaluation on data these blocks did not select. The reserved confirmatory blocks remain reserved; five falsifications have not unreserved them.
development_outcome.what_survives_and_is_worth_keeping: The refusal machinery did exactly what it was declared to do: an unfittable tail was refused by name rather than admitted, and the population was reported. A previously unnamed condition was found and named -- at twelve features a few configurations are so nearly isotropic that their principal axis is refused, so they carry no bearing block and the metric will not compare them with anything that does. Measured extent: none at six or nine features, and 1, 1 and 2 configurations out of 1,320 in three of the four blocks at twelve. `comparable_subset` now refuses those by name instead of crashing.
